payload.title: Upgrade terminal harness to basicly v0.29.0

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
- basicly hooks-check passes with v0.29.0
- basicly check reports no projection drift
- basicly.toml and .basicly-local have no changes
- basicly verify --mode full passes

payload.name: description
payload.value:
## Trigger
When the session start reports that the tracker kit is from basicly 0.26.11 and the engine is 0.29.0, I want terminal to install basicly v0.29.0, so I can read the ledger and keep the harness current.

## Scope
- `.basicly/**`
- `.claude/**`
- `.agents/**`
- `.codex/**`
- `.github/**`
- `.vscode/tasks.json`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `CLAUDE.md`
- `changelog.d/**`
- `terminal_setup/configs.py`
- `docs/**`

Install the published v0.29.0 wheel. Preserve basicly.toml, consumer overlays and Codex preferences. Align the setup and contributor pins.

payload.name: requirements
payload.value:
- The tracker kit and the engine report the same basicly version at session start
- Every basicly pin in the repository names v0.29.0

payload.title: Windows setup hangs at the add to user PATH step

payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
- The add to user PATH command returns without waiting for the environment broadcast
- Every powershell launch in terminal_setup passes -NoProfile

payload.name: description
payload.value:
## Trigger
When a customer runs the install.ps1 one-liner, setup stops at the add to user PATH step, so I want that step to finish without waiting on other windows, so I can install on any Windows machine.

## Cause
SendMessageTimeout with HWND_BROADCAST waits up to the timeout for each top-level window (Microsoft Learn, SendMessageTimeoutA). The 5000 ms timeout times many slow windows blocks setup once per added directory. The PATH update and WezTerm install also loaded the user profile (no -NoProfile).

## Scope
- `terminal_setup/prerequisites.py`
- `tests/test_terminal_setup/test_prerequisites.py`
- `changelog.d/**`

payload.name: requirements
payload.value: - A Windows setup run completes the add to user PATH step on a machine with unresponsive windows
